title: So we all know Scorsese has another solid mob movie left in him, what story/period/subject do you think would be the best for him to cover?

commenti.body: I personally don’t want him to touch the mob as a topic again. Realistically he only has a few more films left to give the public, and I’d like to see what else he has to say within different, perhaps more personal stories. The Irishman was an introspective, touching sendoff to his work in the ‘mob genre’, and I think it’d best to leave it there.
